title: What Happened and What Was Going On
label: ch:ta-what-happened-and-what-was-going-on
canDo: I can say what happened in the past for every person (vantēṉ, vantāṉ, vantārkaḷ), set the scene with -koṇṭiruntēṉ and vanta pōtu, say what there was with iruntatu, and say what did not happen with -villai.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 284: tell what happened, what was going on and what was there, with the past by person, -koṇṭiruntēṉ, vanta pōtu and iruntatu.
